{{Top|leg}}
An '''electric sparker''' was a device capable of delivering an electric shock. It came in a handheld variety. An [[Alien/Legends|alien]] once amused itself in a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] by shocking themselves with the sparker and giggling at the sensation.<ref name="RPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
